steps.message: Move the file sci_fi_book.mp3 from Notifications within the sdk_gphone_x86_64 storage area to the Audiobooks within the same sdk_gphone_x86_64 storage area in the Android filesystem.

Execute: adb shell "SRC1='/storage/emulated/0/Notifications/sci_fi_book.mp3'; SRC2='/sdcard/Notifications/sci_fi_book.mp3'; DSTDIR='/storage/emulated/0/Audiobooks'; mkdir -p \"$DSTDIR\"; if [ -f \"$SRC1\" ]; then mv \"$SRC1\" \"$DSTDIR/\"; echo 'MOVED_FROM=SRC1'; elif [ -f \"$SRC2\" ]; then mv \"$SRC2\" \"$DSTDIR/\"; echo 'MOVED_FROM=SRC2'; else echo 'NOT_FOUND'; fi; echo 'DEST:'; ls -l \"$DSTDIR/sci_fi_book.mp3\" 2>&1; echo 'SOURCE_CHECK:'; ls -l /storage/emulated/0/Notifications/sci_fi_book.mp3 /sdcard/Notifications/sci_fi_book.mp3 2>&1"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "SRC1='/storage/emulated/0/Notifications/sci_fi_book.mp3'; SRC2='/sdcard/Notifications/sci_fi_book.mp3'; DSTDIR='/storage/emulated/0/Audiobooks'; mkdir -p \"$DSTDIR\"; if [ -f \"$SRC1\" ]; then mv \"$SRC1\" \"$DSTDIR/\"; echo 'MOVED_FROM=SRC1'; elif [ -f \"$SRC2\" ]; then mv \"$SRC2\" \"$DSTDIR/\"; echo 'MOVED_FROM=SRC2'; else echo 'NOT_FOUND'; fi; echo 'DEST:'; ls -l \"$DSTDIR/sci_fi_book.mp3\" 2>&1; echo 'SOURCE_CHECK:'; ls -l /storage/emulated/0/Notifications/sci_fi_book.mp3 /sdcard/Notifications/sci_fi_book.mp3 2>&1""
